text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a gain felt rewarding, but I should decide whether to sell based on my plan and portfolio needs, not the satisfaction of locking in profit.","My account fell after earlier periods, then recovered somewhat; these random moves do not tell me what prices will do next, so I should avoid treating recent performance as a forecast.","I should review position sizes and diversification regularly, and make deliberate choices rather than letting loss aversion lead me to hold automatically or trade impulsively."]}
